build.//: Four ways in, in increasing order of effort for the tester.

go.//: Not a build at all. `npm run go` serves the bundle over a tunnel and prints a QR code; anyone with Expo Go is in the app in ten seconds. No account, no install, no TestFlight.

preview.//: An installable build for people without a developer account. Android gets an APK they can sideload from a link; iOS needs ad-hoc provisioning or TestFlight.

development.//: The full thing, including the Live Activity, widgets, Control Center control and App Intents. This is the only profile where the system surfaces exist.
